cmd.desc: Choose the language Mewvo uses for you
cmd.set: Pick your language: Mewvo then uses it for messages meant for you
cmd.panel: Post a panel where members pick their language
cmd.channel: Where to post the panel (default: this channel)

pick.title: Your language
pick.text: Pick the language Mewvo should use for messages meant for you. A language with a role here gives you that role (your other language roles are removed); one without a role is saved as your personal language.
pick.textPersonal: Pick the language Mewvo should use for your DMs and for answers only you see. This server has no language roles, so it is saved as your personal language, in every server (a language role in a server still comes first there).
pick.personalOption: No role here: saved as your personal language

panel.title: Choose your language
panel.text: Click your language. Mewvo then uses it for messages meant for you (answers, DMs, level-ups). Click another one to switch.
panel.noPerms: I can't post in {channel}: I need View Channel, Send Messages and Embed Links there.
panel.textOnly: Pick a text channel for the panel.

notSetUp: This server has no language roles yet. An admin can set them on the dashboard (Bot language).
notYours: This menu belongs to someone else. Run /language set yourself.
done: Done. Mewvo now uses {language} for messages meant for you.

error.notOffered: {language} has no role in this server yet.
error.memberMissing: I could not find you in this server.
error.noManageRoles: I need the Manage Roles permission to change language roles. Ask an admin.
error.roleMissing: The role for {language} no longer exists. Ask an admin to pick it again on the dashboard.
error.managed: The role **{role}** is managed by an integration, so I can't give or remove it.
error.dangerous: The role **{role}** has staff permissions, so I won't hand it out. Ask an admin to pick another language role.
error.hierarchy: The role **{role}** is not below my highest role, so I can't give or remove it. Ask an admin to move my role up.
error.failed: Discord refused the role change. Try again in a moment.
error.dbDown: The settings can't be read right now (database not responding). Nothing was changed.
error.saveFailed: Your language could not be saved (database not responding). Nothing was changed.

saved: Saved: Mewvo will DM you in {language} and use it for answers only you see. A language role in a server still comes first there.
resetDone: Cleared: Mewvo uses each server's language for your DMs again.
roleKept: -# Your language role in this server still comes first here: {reason}
